title: Mike Neal and first playing with George Lewis
summary: Mike Neal lived with Howard; the 1940s recordings and early work with George Lewis before Bunk Johnson.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Did you ever play with Mike Neal, bro?

Mike Neal, bro, played with me. In fact he lived with me before I went overseas. I left him at the house when I lived on St. Philip Street. He was staying with me. And he played with me in the big band.
Before you went overseas, you mean to play with George? Yeah.
When did you start playing with George anyhow? That's a long story, I know.
Well I played with George on the records when Bill recorded us I think in the 40s, the Swiss record. I recorded with George, but most of the time George used to play with me before he got with

I never had played with George. Yeah, I did play with him a while at Maness, like that, but before that George wasn't operating no band he was playing with different fellas until after he got with Bunk.
When did you play with him at Maness? That must have been a while back. Was Jim in the band then or was it just five pieces or what?

I think Jim used to play once in a while, but I played back there off and on with him. That's before I think he went with Bunk. Or he was back from Bunk or something like that, before he went into Elba Rock I'm sure
of that. He was in the 40s and sometimes. He was in the 40s and sometimes.
